source: Build398 existing 17-character assets; only 13 characters replaced
outputs: 13 characters x 8 motions = 104 transparent 512x512 PNG files
process: Restoration sheets split mechanically, transparent fringes retained, common reference scale and visible foot baseline. ten_chaos used an ImageGen-restored opaque sheet with a deterministic background cutout and explicit protection of white cloth. No gameplay stats changed.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached transparent 2048x1024 RPG sprite atlas, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight 512x512 cells of ONE existing character. Repair this SAME atlas, preserving character identity, pose in each cell, scale, pixel-art texture, blue eyes, pale silver-blue bob hair, white/navy/gold ornate costume, hornlike halo ornaments and blue-white crescent bow. The severe defect is accidental transparency holes through the TOP OF THE HAIR in cells 1,2,3,4,7,8 and pale costume/ribbon areas. Restore opaque silver-blue hair and opaque cloth where material was accidentally removed. Cell 5 (bottom left walking pose) and cell 6 show how the intact silver-blue hair must look. Do NOT fill the open center of the halo or intentional gaps between ribbon strips, arms, bow, legs. Preserve those as true transparency. Also complete any abruptly cut off ribbon/weapon/effect tips inside each cell. No redesign, no changed face, no extra limbs, no new ornaments, no captions, no cell lines. Keep the same eight distinct motions in row-major order: idle1, idle2, idle3, walk1, walk2, attack, damage, down. Maintain a small clear transparent gap between cells and transparent margins; nothing from one cell enters another. Result must be a genuine RGBA PNG with transparent background, NOT black/white/checkerboard painted background. Output 2048x1024 if possible, exact 2:1 aspect ratio and 4x2 evenly spaced cell layout.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided 4x2 sprite atlas. Remove the gray CHECKERBOARD and faint watermark-like background pattern completely. Deliver an actual transparent PNG cutout, with an alpha channel where the background was. Keep all eight existing sprites, their exact positions, shape, color, silver hair, pale cloth, and pale weapons unchanged. White and silver material must remain opaque. The centers of halos and gaps between limbs and ribbons should be transparent. No new painted background, no simulated checkerboard, no text. True transparent background output.
